bathymetry_ingest.valid_pixel_rule: native TIFF mask valid AND finite; honor explicit source nodata if present; no distribution-derived or value-sign-derived mask
bathymetry_ingest.georeference_rule: use embedded raster transform if it is non-identity and 3 m; otherwise require exactly one source .tfw and apply standard world-file pixel-center to raster-corner conversion
bathymetry_ingest.coordinate_reference: source UTM Zone 10 NAD83(2011); no reprojection needed for within-tile morphology

blind_sampling_transfer.common_center_validity: blind sample centers must have complete valid support out to the maximum frozen radius 96 m before any radius-specific scoring
